messages:
Jordan: Heads-up — drafting release note for v2.14.0. Cutover window 03/25 02:00 UTC. Need: 1) pin owner, 2) confirm rollback gates, 3) final microcopy. Draft below.

Sam: i'll take pin for this one. what are rollback thresholds?

Jordan: thanks @Sam. Rollback gates:
- error rate > 3% for 10m
- latency p95 > 2s and user impact detected
- model-regression alert from Optimize evals
If any gate trips, immediate pin rollback to v2.13.7 and notify #eng-oncall.

Liz: noted. Can you add a short blurb for internal announce? Will stitch into blast.

Jordan: sure — draft blurb:

```
Heads-up: We'll release v2.14.0 on 03/25 02:00 UTC. This rollout includes batching improvements and a quantization tweak for the llama-compat model. Expected impact: lower cost per token and slight p95 improvements. Pin owner: @Sam. Oncall: @Ben. If you see >3% errors or significant latency regressions, trigger rollback to v2.13.7 and ping eng-oncall.
```

Maya: nit — add note about dedicated fallback: "auto-fallback to cpu-safe variant if GPU capacity constrained".

Jordan: good call. Updated in the snippet.

DeployBot: scheduled deploy for v2.14.0 -> staging at 1747628500.

Sam: i pushed a tiny edit to the blurb (clarified quantization scope).

Ben: I'll be oncall for the window. Please DM if anything odd. Also add the canary cadence: 10% for first 15m, 50% next 15m, then 100% if green.

Jordan: added canary cadence and updated rollback steps in the RN draft. Can someone do a quick copy + legal check? We need to send internal announce by EOD today.

Liz: I'll run copycheck and ping legal.

Sam: final question — do we pin the model version or runtime? Recommend pinning model version (v2.14.0-model) and keep runtime loose for infra fixes.

Jordan: agreed. Model version pinned; runtime can be hotfixable. I'll update the rollout playbook and attach to the internal blast.

Maya: :thumbsup: Anything else?

Liz: legal gave the OK for the blurb.

Jordan: perfect — closing RN draft. I'm scheduling the internal announcement at 18:00 PT and adding the deploybot cadence. Thanks all :rocket:
